company.name: Gecko Robotics
company.shortDescription: Gecko Robotics is an AI and robotics technology company that provides robotics and inspection services for industrial applications.
company.description: Gecko Robotics provides robotics and inspection services, particularly for industrial applications. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall-climbing robots, industry-leading sensors, and an AI-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real-time decision-making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure.

productsAndServices.description: A software-as-a-service operating platform that combines robotic inspection data, facility records, and AI analysis to support asset-health management, predictive maintenance, budgeting, and operational decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Cantilever®

productsAndServices.description: An integrated technology capability that uses robots, sensors, and artificial intelligence to collect high-fidelity physical data, identify asset risks, and support maintenance and production decisions.
productsAndServices.name: AI + Robotics (AIR)

productsAndServices.description: AI- and robotics-enabled production and quality-assurance services that digitize manufacturing workflows from design through assembly and inspection of welds, castings, forgings, and finished components.
productsAndServices.name: Advanced Manufacturing

productsAndServices.description: Robotic inspection and asset-sustainment services that establish condition baselines, monitor degradation, detect defects, and guide maintenance throughout the life of industrial infrastructure.
productsAndServices.name: Industrial Inspection and Sustainment Services

productsAndServices.description: Aerial data-capture services that use drones or other aerial robotic systems to inspect and document industrial assets and infrastructure that are difficult or unsafe to access manually.

aiResearchSummary.text: Gecko Robotics is engaged in developing systems, methods, and apparatus for concrete quality inspection, inspection robots with modular components and high configurability, and robotic systems for ultrasonic surface inspection using shaped elements. Their research includes inspection robots with profile adapting sleds, couplant reduction films, and systems for ultrasonic inspection of surfaces. These efforts focus on advancing robotic inspection and data integration for industrial applications.
